data.title: Affinity matured cd47-specific humanized antibody
data.abstract: The present invention relates to an affinity matured CD47-specific humanized antibody and, more specifically, to an affinity matured CD47-specific humanized antibody and a pharmaceutical composition comprising the affinity matured CD47-specific humanized antibody, for preventing or treating a disease mediated by cells overexpressing CD47. In the present invention, a humanized antibody (Hu3A5V10 antibody) was prepared by using a CD47-binding antibody (3A5 antibody), and the humanized anti-CD47 antibody was confirmed to bind specifically to a CD47 antigen. In addition, three types of the humanized anti-CD47 antibody in which affinity of the humanized anti-CD47 antibody was matured were prepared, and these antibodies were confirmed to have increased binding strength and affinity with the antigen. Thus, the affinity matured humanized antibody binding specifically to CD47 according to the present invention can be effectively applied to the prevention or treatment of diseases or tumors in which the immune response is suppressed by overexpression of CD47.
